items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: my agent handles about eight big American stars, such as people like Teddy Wilson

ctx.x: Yes, remember we played just a few gigs engagements. Too bad that it didn't come off, but it needed financing. It was way ahead of its time because I think Benny was not to -- Lionel and Teddy were not to join Benny Goodman until --

items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Bud Freeman did a lot of them [dates]

ctx.x: And the trombones would be Red Ballard and Vernon Brown, the reeds would be Hymie Schertzer on alto and probably George Koenig: Bill DePew on third alto, the tenor would have been Babe Rusin or Bud Freeman or Vico Muso and Arthur Rollini, Adrian's younger brother. That would have been the real personnel. And of course, Stacey on the piano.
